defs.def: a book containing lists of information, usually in alphabetical order, for example people's telephone numbers or the names and addresses of businesses in a particular area 名录；电话号码簿；公司名录

ex.s: So, I called Directory Assistance, got put through to our landlady’s managing agent, and had a spare key sent to me with just enough time to get back in before the actors arrived.
ex.t: 于是我打了查号台，转接到房东的代理处，让人送了一把备用钥匙过来，刚好能在演员到达之前赶回去开门。

ex.s: Make both print and digital versions of the directory.
ex.t: 制作印刷版和数字版的名录。

ex.s: They will be added to the directory so we can identify them in the future.
ex.t: 它们将被添加到名录中，以便我们将来能识别它们。

ex.s: A list of the buildings destroyed would be a directory of San Francisco.
ex.t: 被毁建筑名单就是旧金山的一份名录。

ex.s: You should also look through the business directory to see who your main competitors will be and find out how their businesses work.
ex.t: 你还应该查阅商业名录，了解你的主要竞争对手是谁，以及他们的公司是如何运作的。

defs.def: a file containing a group of other files or programs in a computer （计算机文件或程序的）目录
